table: # Rename lines map a removed row to a new row of the same table: new_identifier, new_kind and new_file name the new row.
# Retirement line (INV-T-17435, INV-Q-17427 A): the token RETIRED in each of new_identifier, new_kind and new_file, and in
# ruling a Keel question key matching ^INV-Q-[0-9]+$. It exempts one removed row (same table, old_identifier, old_kind, old_file)
# only if the head holds no row with that triple and the element is really absent from <dir>/<old_file> at the head (kind
# operation: no operationId equal to old_identifier). The map is read from the base commit. RETIRED in only some of the three
# cells, a duplicate line for one table and old triple, or an unruled line is a finding.
